description:
Your legal team requires a mandatory Terms of Service agreement at checkout. 

1. Create a new Basic Page titled "Terms and Conditions" with some placeholder legal text (e.g., "By placing an order, you agree...").
2. Configure the default Checkout Flow to enable the "Terms of service" pane. Place it in the "Sidebar" or "Review" step.
3. Configure the pane settings to link to your newly created "Terms and Conditions" page.

The Drupal admin credentials are admin / Admin1234! and the site is at http://localhost.
